title: DocMap activity log entry (riga del Registro attività)
description: One user operation (logAct / logNorm in assets/js/06e-log.js). Same shape in memory (LOG.entries), in the workspace JSON key activity_log, in sync packages, in server pull/push (activity_log) and, flattened, in the SQLite table activity_log (target_type/target_id/target_code, details_json). Entries are append-only: merged by id, never modified. Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §7.2.

id.description: Unique id (uuid; entries written by the server for a phone patch may use 32 hex characters).

who.description: settings.operator of the device, 'Questo PC' when empty; server user for phone patches.

action.description: Stable id '<group>.<verb>' (binder.create, binder.edit, binder.locate, import.merge, print.pdf, sync.import, sync.restore, location.create, undo, ...). New actions may appear at any time.

type.description: binder · client · info · session · file · location · settings · ...

details.description: Small JSON: {changed:{field:[old, new]}}, counts, codes, file names, binder.locate {from, to, via, device, user}, ... An EMPTY object comes back from the PHP server as [] (json_decode with assoc: {} and [] are the same PHP array); the client accepts both.
